verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an identity and fraud decisioning API platform like Alloy, so the axis applies. None of the evidence items mention a sandbox, test environment, or isolation from production data. The items cover the Events API, webhooks, health monitoring, workflows and SSO, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
